moral_character_required.quote: An applicant, and each officer, director, partner, manager, associate, and responsible managing employee thereof, shall not have committed acts or crimes that are grounds for denial of licensure under Section 480.

degree_required.value: No formal degree required; applicant must demonstrate knowledge and experience in the classification applied for
degree_required.quote: The board shall require an applicant to show the degree of knowledge and experience in the classification applied for, and the general knowledge of the building, safety, health, and lien laws of the state and of the administrative principles of the contracting business

degree_level.quote: The board shall require an applicant to show the degree of knowledge and experience in the classification applied for, and the general knowledge of the building, safety, health, and lien laws of the state and of the administrative principles of the contracting business

experience_source.quote: The board shall require an applicant to show the degree of knowledge and experience in the classification applied for, and the general knowledge of the building, safety, health, and lien laws of the state and of the administrative principles of the contracting business that the board deems necessary for the safety and protection of the public.

kind.value: experience in the classification applied for (construction work experience)
kind.quote: The board shall require an applicant to show the degree of knowledge and experience in the classification applied for

exams.name: Contractors License Written Examination
exams.notes: Examination includes questions on knowledge required by Section 7068, laws of the state, and the contracting business and trade. Examination may be waived under specific circumstances per Sections 7065.1, 7065.2, 7065.3, and 7065.4.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by or under contract with the Contractors State License Board)
exams.quote: the registrar shall investigate, classify, and qualify applicants for contractors' licenses by written examination. This examination shall include questions designed to show that the applicant has the necessary degree of knowledge required by Section 7068 and shall include pertinent questions relating to the laws of this state and the contracting business and trade.

available.quote: The registrar may accept the qualifications of an applicant who is licensed as a contractor in a similar classification in another state if that state accepts the qualifications of a contractor licensed in this state for purposes of licensure in that other state, and if the board ascertains, on a case-by-case basis, that the professional qualifications and conditions of good standing for licensure and continued licensure are at least the same or greater in that state as in California.

requirements.value: Reciprocal state must accept CA qualifications; board ascertains on case-by-case basis that the other state's qualifications are at least equal to California's. Trade examination may be waived if applicant provides written certification that the out-of-state license has been in good standing for the previous five years.
requirements.quote: The registrar may accept the qualifications of an applicant who is licensed as a contractor in a similar classification in another state if that state accepts the qualifications of a contractor licensed in this state for purposes of licensure in that other state, and if the board ascertains, on a case-by-case basis, that the professional qualifications and conditions of good standing for licensure and continued licensure are at least the same or greater in that state as in California. The registrar may waive the trade examination for that applicant if the applicant provides written certification from that other state in which he or she is licensed, that the applicant's license has been in good standing for the previous five years.

exists.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Contractors State License Board, which consists of 15 members.

credential_type.quote: Contractors' licenses are to be issued to individual owners, partnerships, corporations, limited liability companies, and participating tribes, in accordance with this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: it is a misdemeanor for a person to engage in the business of, or act in the capacity of, a contractor within this state under either of the following conditions: (1) The person is not licensed in accordance with this chapter.

title_protection.quote: It is a misdemeanor for any person to advertise for construction or work of improvement covered by this chapter unless that person holds a valid license under this chapter in the classification so advertised

scope_protection.quote: it is a misdemeanor for a person to engage in the business of, or act in the capacity of, a contractor within this state under either of the following conditions: (1) The person is not licensed in accordance with this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment without legal excuse of any construction project or operation engaged in or undertaken by the licensee as a contractor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment without legal excuse of any construction project or operation engaged in or undertaken by the licensee as a contractor constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diversion of funds or property received for prosecution or completion of a specific construction project or operation, or failure to account for such funds.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Diversion of funds or property received for prosecution or completion of a specific construction project or operation, or for a specified purpose in the prosecution or completion of any construction project or operation, or failure substantially to account for the application or use of such funds or property on the construction project or operation for which such funds or property were received constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful departure in any material respect from accepted trade standards for good and workmanlike construction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A willful departure in any material respect from accepted trade standards for good and workmanlike construction constitutes a cause for disciplinary action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate disregard and violation of the building laws of the state or any political subdivision thereof.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate disregard and violation of the building laws of the state, or of any political subdivision thereof, or of any of the following references to or provisions of law, constitutes a cause for disciplinary action against a licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to make and keep records showing all contracts, documents, records, receipts, and disbursements, or refusal to make records available for inspection by the registrar.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to make and keep records showing all contracts, documents, records, receipts, and disbursements by a licensee of all of his or her transactions as a contractor, and failure to have those records available for inspection by the registrar or his or her duly authorized representative for a period of not less than five years after completion of any construction project or operation to which the records refer, or refusal by a licensee to comply with a written request of the registrar to make the records available for inspection constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Omission or misrepresentation of a material fact by an applicant or a licensee in obtaining, renewing, or adding a classification to a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Omission or misrepresentation of a material fact by an applicant or a licensee in obtaining, or renewing a license, or in adding a classification to an existing license constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure in a material respect to complete any construction project or operation for the price stated in the contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure in a material respect on the part of a licensee to complete any construction project or operation for the price stated in the contract for such construction project or operation or in any modification of such contract constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the provisions of this chapter or allowing one's license to be used by an unlicensed person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the provisions of this chapter or combining or conspiring with an unlicensed person, or allowing one's license to be used by an unlicensed person, or acting as agent or partner or associate, or otherwise, of an unlicensed person with the intent to evade the provisions of this chapter constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this chapter, or any rule or regulation adopted pursuant to this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this chapter, or any rule or regulation adopted pursuant to this chapter, or to comply with the provisions of Section 7106 of the Public Contract Code, constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Doing of any willful or fraudulent act by the licensee as a contractor in consequence of which another is substantially injured.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The doing of any wilful or fraudulent act by the licensee as a contractor in consequence of which another is substantially injured constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting as a contractor under any license except in the name of the licensee as set forth on the license or in accordance with the personnel of the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any license issued hereunder except: (a) in the name of the licensee as set forth upon the license, or (b) in accordance with the personnel of the licensee as set forth in the application for such license, or as later changed as provided in this chapter, constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into a contract with a contractor while that contractor is not licensed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entering into a contract with a contractor while such contractor is not licensed as provided in this chapter constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful failure or refusal without legal excuse to prosecute a construction project with reasonable diligence causing material injury.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilful failure or refusal without legal excuse on the part of a licensee as a contractor to prosecute a construction project or operation with reasonable diligence causing material injury to another constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate failure to pay any moneys when due for materials or services rendered in connection with operations as a contractor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilful or deliberate failure by any licensee or agent or officer thereof, to pay any moneys, when due for any materials or services rendered in connection with his operations as a contractor, when he has the capacity to pay or when he has received sufficient funds therefor as payment for the particular construction work, project, or operation for which the services or materials were rendered or purchased constitutes a cause for disciplinary action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions, and duties of a contractor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A conviction of a crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions and duties of a contractor constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of safety provisions in applicable regulations, or violation of Labor Code safety provisions resulting in death or serious injury.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any safety provision in, or authorized by, Article 12 (commencing with Section 3420) of Group 3 of Subchapter 7 of Chapter 4 of Division 1 of Title 8 of the California Code of Regulations constitutes a cause for disciplinary action without regard to whether death or serious injury to an employee resulted from the violation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that subverts or attempts to subvert an investigation of the board, or threatening/harassing persons providing evidence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is a cause for discipline for a licensee to do any of the following: (a) Engage in any conduct that subverts or attempts to subvert an investigation of the board. (b) Threaten or harass any person or licensee for providing evidence in any possible or actual disciplinary action, arbitration, or other legal action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under a license that has been made inactive, suspended, or expired.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any license which has been made inactive, as provided in Section 7076.5, constitutes a cause for disciplinary action. (b) Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any license that has been suspended for any reason constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in the capacity of a contractor in a classification other than that currently held by the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor in a classification other than that currently held by the licensee constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action of a contractor license by another state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action of a license to act as a contractor by another state shall constitute grounds for disciplinary action in this state if the individual is a licensee, or applies for a license, in this state.

bonding_required.quote: The board shall require as a condition precedent to the issuance, reinstatement, reactivation, renewal, or continued maintenance of a license, that the applicant or licensee file or have on file a contractor's bond in the sum of twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000).

insurance_required.quote: the board shall require as a condition precedent to the issuance, reinstatement, reactivation, renewal, or continued maintenance of a license, that the applicant or licensee have on file at all times a current and valid Certificate of Workers' Compensation Insurance or Certification of Self-Insurance in the applicant's or licensee's business name.

definition_quote.value: a contractor is any person who undertakes to or offers to undertake to, or purports to have the capacity to undertake to, or submits a bid to, or does himself or herself or by or through others, construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck or demolish any building, highway, road, parking facility, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development or improvement, or to do any part thereof
definition_quote.quote: a contractor is any person who undertakes to or offers to undertake to, or purports to have the capacity to undertake to, or submits a bid to, or does himself or herself or by or through others, construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck or demolish any building, highway, road, parking facility, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development or improvement, or to do any part thereof

methods_authorized.quote: the contracting business includes any or all of the following branches: (a) General engineering contracting. (b) (1) General building contracting. (2) Residential remodeling contracting. (c) Specialty contracting.

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: Every person licensed pursuant to this chapter shall include his license number in: (a) all construction contracts; (b) subcontracts and calls for bid; and (c) all forms of advertising, as prescribed by the registrar of contractors, used by such a person.

self_insurance_permitted.quote: the board shall require as a condition precedent to the issuance, reinstatement, reactivation, renewal, or continued maintenance of a license, that the applicant or licensee have on file at all times a current and valid Certificate of Workers' Compensation Insurance or Certification of Self-Insurance in the applicant's or licensee's business name.

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: This chapter does not apply to a work or operation on one undertaking or project by one or more contracts if the aggregate contract price for labor, materials, and all other items is less than one thousand dollars ($1,000)

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: Nothing contained in this section shall be construed as authorizing a city or county to enact regulations relating to the qualifications necessary to engage in the business of contracting.

local_trade_licensing_preserved.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall limit the power of a city or county to regulate the quality and character of installations made by contractors through a system of permits and inspections which are designed to secure compliance with and aid in the enforcement of applicable state and local building laws

out_of_state_disciplinary_action_reporti.quote: The revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action of a license to act as a contractor by another state shall constitute grounds for disciplinary action in this state if the individual is a licensee, or applies for a license, in this state.
